theme.description: A welcoming women’s health practice with arched portraiture, pink and lilac planes, a detailed service directory and personal callback journeys.
principles: Preserve generous white opening space, rounded arches and asymmetric badge overlaps.
Organize care by patient questions, then explain details in readable columns.
Repeat a clear callback invitation at useful transitions without hiding information.
Keep a calm shell; use pastel panels and thoughtful photography for warmth.
theme.image: Original generated fictional floral portrait, two practitioner portraits and consultation photograph.
theme.motion: Immediately readable opening; manual practitioner and testimonial carousels, restrained 220–250ms menu/slide feedback. Reduced motion settles decorative changes. No forced autoplay.
theme.freedoms: Re-author clinic information, services and sitemap for the real practice. These 27 fictional demonstration routes illustrate layout groups, not a mandatory customer sitemap.
theme.brandRule: Customer name/logo retain their geometry. Customer color appears in the decorative key and a contrast-safe companion fills actions. Warm pastel surfaces and dark readable type preserve the design identity.
theme.license: Original Vitris authored HTML/CSS/JS/SVG and fictional copy. Original generated fictional photography. Urbanist and Caveat SIL OFL 1.1 fonts with notices. Reference imagery, identities and clinical claims excluded.

principles: Lowercase Instrument Serif balances uppercase Anton.
Food photography leads; tiny mono labels hold the details.
Float the navigation, connect the process, keep the counter inviting.
theme.image: Thirteen original generated food and diner photographs.
theme.motion: Winding scroll story, tilted specials and social photo rows, serif footer ticker, pausable photo stories and accessible local dialogs; reduced-motion final content.
theme.freedoms: Re-author food, claims, articles, policies and route choices for the actual business.
theme.brandRule: Customer name/logo and contrast-safe accent recolor controls and identity planes while preserving cream paper and editorial typography.
theme.license: Original authored markup, styles, copy and generated photographs; Instrument Serif and Anton under bundled SIL OFL 1.1 notices.
theme.geometry: Pill controls, rounded photos, circular process and a door-shaped visit panel.
theme.responsive: Desktop split layouts and category rail become stacked mobile sections; food cards and gallery controls remain usable at 320px.

theme.name: Evermere Care
theme.description: A warm, expansive care-provider website with cream and teal surfaces, elegant serif type, gold handwritten accents, overlapping photography, home finding, community stories and thoughtful enquiry journeys.
principles: Warm cream and deep teal establish a reassuring rhythm.
Serif headings and handwritten gold accents pair with clear sans-serif reading text.
Generous sections, overlapping photographs and distinct care pathways preserve the reference’s narrative hierarchy.
Separate home tours and resident visits; keep personal support easy to explore.
theme.image: Cleared illustrative Pexels photography, pinned with source and credit records.
theme.motion: Restrained 600 ms section accents, photo hover zoom, manual carousels and accessible drawers; reduced motion and global pause preserve immediate content.
theme.freedoms: Re-author every business fact, home, place, service, story and route for a real customer. Preserve the design relationships and task structure.
theme.brandRule: Customer name/logo and contrast-safe customer accent flow through all routes. Cream, gold and typography preserve the template identity.
theme.license: Original Vitris HTML, CSS, JavaScript and copy; Pexels License illustrative photographs; SIL OFL fonts with notices. No proprietary reference assets or certification claims.
theme.geometry: Rectangular buttons and cards; circular directional controls; overlapping rectangular photographs.
theme.responsive: Desktop mega menus switch to a nested drawer below 1024px; stacked layouts below 651px; tested at 320–1440px.

principles: Connect every frame to one clear idea
Dark violet depth with precise magenta accents
Use media to show the creative process
Keep reusable branding and useful interactions central
theme.image: Original editable vector motion workspaces and fictional project identities.
theme.motion: Gentle workspace float, continuous logo rows, bounded scroll accents, carousel movement, and locally animated project previews. Reduced motion and a saved pause settle decorative motion.

theme.responsive: Desktop grouped mega menus; mobile drawer, stacked heroes, two and one column cards, horizontally contained pricing tables.
theme.freedoms: Replace project content, editorial copy, pricing, and original illustrations while retaining composition and semantic controls.
theme.brandRule: Customer name/logo and accent action color flow across every recipe; contrast-adjusted accent text remains readable. Violet remains the supporting motion scene palette.

theme.name: Lumen Billing
theme.description: A complete fictional SaaS billing direction: restrained Inter, generous white and cool pale surfaces, near-black actions, selective violet, a fine square grid, editable product UI, original human photography and 26 connected routes.
principles: Give payments and renewals a clear context.
Use medium-weight type and generous space to make complex work readable.
Keep black actions, selective accent and pale product wells in distinct roles.
Use original fictional people and honest local demonstration states.
theme.image: Original fictional office, editorial and portrait photography with detailed editable dashboard, checkout, invoice, plan and payment-link illustrations.
theme.motion: Immediate static reading. Restrained color hovers, 2px integration lift and job arrows; reduced motion disables transitions. No autoplay or scroll reveals.
theme.freedoms: Adapt copy and content to a verified business; retain the page-specific narrative, readable product UI and consistent article records.
theme.brandRule: Original is the Lumen identity. Customer mode substitutes name, logo and contrast-safe accent across controls, product UI and CTA, retaining cool neutral reading surfaces and deliberate dark mode.
theme.license: Original Vitris-authored demonstration copy, HTML/SVG product artwork and built-in imagegen fictional photography. Inter is SIL OFL 1.1; notices and provenance included in private recoverable source.
theme.geometry: Fine square grids, 8–16px cards and controls, circular geometric mark, asymmetric product pairs and page-specific reading measures.
theme.responsive: Full-height accessible menu below 1024px; 1/2/3 column grids; desktop/mobile article, auth and legal measures; all 26 routes.

history.audience: Growing software teams, founders and billing operators exploring subscription and payment workflows.

pages.label: Build a back office that stays connected
Bring useful product answers into chat
Keep membership and billing in step
Build for creators in more places

theme.name: Parallax Studio
theme.description: A violet and magenta motion design agency, with layered workspace illustrations, expansive navigation, project media previews, pricing comparisons, editorial pages, and local creative tools.
principles: Connect every frame to one clear idea
Dark violet depth with precise magenta accents
Use media to show the creative process
Keep reusable branding and useful interactions central
theme.image: Original editable vector motion workspaces and fictional project identities.
theme.motion: Gentle workspace float, continuous logo rows, bounded scroll accents, carousel movement, and locally animated project previews. Reduced motion and a saved pause settle decorative motion.
theme.geometry: Pill actions, fine violet borders, 12px media corners, generous split compositions and aligned three-column cards.
theme.responsive: Desktop grouped mega menus; mobile drawer, stacked heroes, two and one column cards, horizontally contained pricing tables.
theme.freedoms: Replace project content, editorial copy, pricing, and original illustrations while retaining composition and semantic controls.
theme.brandRule: Customer name/logo and accent action color flow across every recipe; contrast-adjusted accent text remains readable. Violet remains the supporting motion scene palette.
theme.license: Original authored HTML/CSS/JS/copy and SVG assets. Artwork released CC0; Inter uses SIL OFL 1.1.

history.audience: Product, marketing, and brand teams exploring motion design and ongoing creative support.

Explain a complex product in one clear story
From visual identity to motion language
Make an AI product easier to understand
